title: My School Day
text:
I go to school every day. My favorite subject is math. We learn numbers and shapes. In the afternoon we have art class.

My best friend, Maria, likes science. She wants to be a doctor one day. We often work together on projects. After school, we go home and eat lunch.

questions.text: What is the narrator's favorite subject?
What does Maria want to be?
Why are Maria and the narrator probably good partners for school projects?
What kind of subjects does the narrator probably enjoy most?

vocabulary.definition: the subject that works with numbers and shapes
the study of the natural world through experiments
pieces of work that students do over a longer time

paragraph_translations: Я ходжу до школи щодня. Мій улюблений предмет — математика. Ми вивчаємо числа і фігури. Вдень у нас є урок малювання.
Моя найкраща подруга Марія любить природничі науки. Вона хоче колись стати лікарką. Ми часто працюємо разом над проєктами. Після школи ми йдемо додому і обідаємо.
